name: Dolly's Factory [Alpha]
desc:
🧸 Welcome to Dolly’s Factory! 
Step into a magical plushie factory where joy comes to life! You are a chosen plushie, brought to life to help power up the factory and keep things running smoothly… but something strange may be lurking between the seams.

✨ Choose your plushie, each with unique abilities

🚂 Travel from zone to zone, fixing up plushie machines

🎀 Watch out for danger, not everything in the factory is friendly...

--------------------------------

NO AI was used in the game!

Full development credits can be found here:
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/c/3953741

--------------------------------

⚠️ Disclaimer: This game is currently in Alpha. You may encounter bugs or unfinished features. We’re actively working to improve the game, thanks for your support and feedback!
